speaking_invitation_statement: Dr. Zaid Amin is available for international academic keynotes, conference plenary talks, institutional workshops, and expert panel discussions on Human-Computer Interaction, AI Governance, Cognitive Attention Systems, and Digital Ethics. To invite Dr. Amin, please contact zaid.amin@newinti.edu.my.

talks.title: Guest Lecture at Sunway University
talks.event: Designing for Every Screen: Responsive Interfaces for Digital Literacy
talks.abstract:
On the morning of 26 November 2026 (8:00–9:45 AM MYT), I had the privilege and honor of being invited as a Guest Lecturer at Sunway University (Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences) for Week 8 of the Digital Media Literacy (COM2023 – COM2024) course in Uni Lecture Theatre 6.

What made this morning truly unforgettable was the remarkable diversity in the room. I had the joy of sharing ideas and learning alongside international students from the United Kingdom, Turkmenistan, Pakistan, Japan, China, and South Korea, together with their Malaysian peers. Teaching interface design in such a multicultural setting is always energizing: every student brings a different set of digital habits, favorite apps, and cultural perspectives on how people read and interact on screens.

talks.title: Guest Lecture: Designing for Every Screen: Responsive Interfaces for Digital Literacy
talks.event: Sunway University - Digital Media Literacy (COM2023–COM2024, Week 8)
talks.location: Uni Lecture Theatre 6, Sunway University, Malaysia
talks.abstract: Interactive guest lecture introducing mobile-first responsive interface design, the 3-Suitcase Breakpoint Rule, Thumb Zone ergonomics, and Adobe XD prototyping for digital literacy campaigns using live ClassPoint activities.
